name: DncEntry
description: A single do-not-contact suppression. Task I2. The contact value is stored only as a keyed hash; the raw phone or email is never persisted here. History is immutable: an entry is expired by status change, never deleted or rewritten.

contact_kind.description: Which contact field this entry suppresses

contact_hash.description: HMAC-SHA256 of the normalized value under DNC_HASH_KEY. Derived only by server/src/lib/dnc.js. The raw value is never stored.

contact_display.description: Heavily masked form for operator lists, for example +1*******89. Never the full value.

scope_value.description: Vertical code or campaign id when scope is narrower than global. An entry with a narrow scope and no value covers nothing.

status.description: Expired entries are retained for audit and never deleted

effective_from.description: When the suppression begins. Absent means immediately.

effective_to.description: When the suppression ends. Absent means indefinitely.

reason.description: Operator facing reason, for example consumer request, litigation, complaint

source.description: Where this entry came from: manual, bulk_import, buyer_feedback, regulator_list

actor.description: User id or system identifier that created the entry

import_batch_id.description: Groups entries created by one bulk import, so an import can be reviewed or expired as a unit
